title: Numerical analysis and coarsening dynamics of the Active Cahn-Hilliard equation
summary: We investigate the analysis and phase ordering dynamics of the active Cahn--Hilliard equation, providing novel results beyond the current state of the art concerning the well-posedness and the characterization of its coarsening dynamics. We consider both regular polynomial and singular logarithmic potentials.
